title: Strong password rules
description: A logged-in user sets a new password on the account page. This is a stricter version of R2, with rules added by a tester for better security.

criteria.AC1: The password must be 8 to 64 characters long.
criteria.AC2: The password must contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit and one special character (such as ! @ # $ %).
criteria.AC3: The new password must not be the same as the current password or any password the user has used before. If it is, the page shows "You cannot reuse a recent password".
criteria.AC4: While the user types, a checklist under the field shows every rule from AC1 and AC2 that is not met yet. Each rule disappears from the checklist as soon as the password meets it.
criteria.AC5: After a successful change, the user sees the message "Password updated".
